-- Skill read model. Operational reads load only the last committed projection
-- body through the read-model contract. Event history and cursor state are not
-- observable here, and this path can never advance a projection.

local contract = require("contract")
local security = require("security")

local types = require("types")

local M = {}
local READ_MODELS = "kickside.core:read_models"

local function trim(value: any): string
    if type(value) ~= "string" then return "" end
    return (value:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
end

local function read_models(): (any?, string?)
    local actor = security.actor()
    if not actor or trim(actor:id()) == "" then return nil, "an authenticated actor is required" end
    local scope = security.scope()
    if not scope then return nil, "a security scope is required" end
    local def, derr = contract.get(READ_MODELS)
    if derr or not def then return nil, "read-model contract unavailable: " .. tostring(derr) end
    local instance, oerr = (def :: any):with_actor(actor):with_scope(scope):open()
    if oerr or not instance then return nil, "read-model open failed: " .. tostring(oerr) end
    return instance, nil
end

function M.thread_for(skill_id: string): (string?, string?)
    skill_id = trim(skill_id)
    if skill_id == "" then return nil, "skill_id is required" end
    return skill_id, nil
end

function M.read_body(skill_id: string): (any, string?)
    skill_id = trim(skill_id)
    if skill_id == "" then return {}, "skill_id is required" end
    local models, merr = read_models()
    if not models then return {}, merr end
    local result, rerr = models:get({
        owner_id = skill_id,
        kind = types.PROJECTION_KIND,
        projection_key = "default",
    })
    if rerr then return {}, tostring(rerr) end
    if type(result) ~= "table" or type((result :: any).body) ~= "table" then return {}, nil end
    return (result :: any).body, nil
end

function M.body_for(skill_id: string): (any, string?)
    return M.read_body(skill_id)
end

function M.versions(body: any): { any }
    local raw = type(body) == "table" and type((body :: any).versions) == "table" and (body :: any).versions or {}
    local out: { any } = {}
    for _, value in ipairs(raw :: { any }) do out[#out + 1] = value end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return (tonumber(a.version) or 0) < (tonumber(b.version) or 0) end)
    return out
end

function M.current_version(body: any): integer
    local current = type(body) == "table" and tonumber((body :: any).current_version) or nil
    if current then return current :: integer end
    local versions = M.versions(body)
    if #versions == 0 then return 0 end
    return (tonumber(versions[#versions].version) or 0) :: integer
end

function M.pick(body: any, selector: any): (any?, string?)
    local versions = M.versions(body)
    if #versions == 0 then return nil, "skill has no versions" end
    if selector == nil then return versions[#versions], nil end
    local wanted = tonumber(selector)
    if not wanted then return nil, "version must be a number" end
    for _, version in ipairs(versions) do
        if (tonumber(version.version) or 0) == wanted then return version, nil end
    end
    return nil, "version not found"
end

return M

-- Type and invariant surfaces for the kickside.skills store + agent surface.
-- A skill is a component (identity / access / kind) whose primary kickside.core
-- thread (thread_id == skill_id) carries the version events. A registered
-- projection folds them into the committed projection body. Bundled files are
-- upload artifacts (one bundle upload per skill, upload_id = skill_id) referenced
-- by artifact_id in each version's manifest.

local M = {}

type Map = { [string]: any }
type Scalar = string | number | boolean

-- A bundled file in a skill version: a reference (loaded into context on demand),
-- an asset (binary dependency), or a script (reserved for the script runner).
-- content is the raw bytes; size_bytes/sha256 describe it. mime_type + metadata
-- (e.g. an inferred script language) aid the agent + the future runner.
type SkillFile = {
    path: string,
    kind: string,
    mime_type: string?,
    size_bytes: integer?,
    sha256: string?,
    executable: boolean?,
    metadata: Map?,
    content: string?,
}

type SkillFileInput = SkillFile & {
    encoding: string?,
}

-- A file as recorded in a version's event manifest: descriptors + the artifact_id
-- its bytes live under (read back via read_artifact_content(skill_id, artifact_id)).
type SkillFileManifest = {
    path: string,
    kind: string,
    mime_type: string?,
    size_bytes: integer,
    sha256: string?,
    executable: boolean?,
    metadata: Map?,
    artifact_id: string,
}

-- A normalized remote skill ready for import. fetch() on a skill_source returns
-- this; skill_create consumes it. files carry content (text or base64) which the
-- store normalizes to raw bytes before storing them as artifacts.
type SkillBundle = {
    name: string,
    description: string?,
    version: string?,
    body: string,
    license: string?,
    allowed_tools: { string }?,
    compatibility: Map?,
    metadata: Map?,
    files: { SkillFileInput }?,
    source: Map?,
}

type SkillCreateArgs = SkillBundle & {
    status: string?,
    agent_id: string?,
    icon: string?,
}

type SkillRefineArgs = {
    skill_id: string?,
    name: string?,
    description: string?,
    body: string?,
    status: string?,
    icon: string?,
    files: { SkillFileInput }?,
    license: string?,
    allowed_tools: { string }?,
    compatibility: Map?,
    metadata: Map?,
    source: Map?,
}

type SkillShareArgs = {
    skill_id: string?,
    user_id: string?,
    access_mask: integer?,
    action: string?,
}

type SkillDeleteArgs = {
    skill_id: string?,
}

type VersionSelector = string | number

type SkillGetArgs = {
    skill_id: string?,
    version: VersionSelector?,
}

type SkillListVersionsArgs = {
    skill_id: string?,
}

type SkillListFilesArgs = {
    skill_id: string?,
    version: VersionSelector?,
    kind: string?,
}

type SkillReadFileArgs = {
    skill_id: string?,
    path: string?,
    version: VersionSelector?,
    max_bytes: VersionSelector?,
    format: string?,
}

type SkillListArgs = {
    include_archived: boolean?,
    agent_id: string?,
    ids: string?,
    q: string?,
    limit: integer?,
}

type SkillToolArgs = {
    action: string?,
    skill_id: string?,
    user_id: string?,
    access_mask: integer?,
    name: string?,
    description: string?,
    body: string?,
    status: string?,
    icon: string?,
    agent_id: string?,
    version: VersionSelector?,
    path: string?,
    kind: string?,
    max_bytes: VersionSelector?,
    format: string?,
    files: { SkillFileInput }?,
    license: string?,
    allowed_tools: { string }?,
    compatibility: Map?,
    metadata: Map?,
    source: Map?,
    include_archived: boolean?,
}

-- Full skill record: component metadata + the current body/version. Returned by
-- skill_store.get. file_count/bundle_size summarize the current version's files.
type Skill = {
    skill_id: string,
    name: string?,
    description: string?,
    status: string?,
    icon: string?,
    body: string,
    version: integer,
    license: string?,
    file_count: integer?,
    bundle_size: integer?,
}

-- Discovery row from skill_store.list: no body (loaded on demand via get()).
type SkillSummary = {
    skill_id: string,
    name: string?,
    description: string?,
    status: string?,
    icon: string?,
    agent_id: string?,
    version: integer?,
    version_count: integer?,
    file_count: integer?,
    bundle_size: integer?,
}

-- One entry in a skill's version history (reader.list_versions). No body — the
-- editor loads a chosen version's body on demand via get({ version }).
type SkillVersion = {
    version: integer,
    name: string?,
    description: string?,
    license: string?,
    file_count: integer?,
    bundle_size: integer?,
    created_at: string?,
}

type SkillFileContent = {
    path: string,
    kind: string,
    mime_type: string?,
    size_bytes: integer,
    sha256: string?,
    executable: boolean?,
    encoding: string,
    content: string,
}

-- A folded version record in the projection body: a version's full snapshot
-- (body + frontmatter + file manifest) so get/list_files/read_file serve any
-- version from the read model without replaying events.
type VersionRecord = {
    version: integer,
    body: string,
    name: string?,
    description: string?,
    license: string?,
    allowed_tools: { string }?,
    compatibility: Map?,
    metadata: Map?,
    source: Map?,
    files: { SkillFileManifest },
    file_count: integer,
    bundle_size: integer,
    created_at: string?,
}

-- skill_store.refine result. version is set only when the body or files changed
-- (a description-only refine leaves it nil).
type RefineResult = { skill_id: string, version: integer? }

-- skill_store.share result.
type ShareResult = { skill_id: string, user_id: string, action: string }
type DeleteResult = { skill_id: string }

type ComponentCommand = {
    type: string,
    payload: Map?,
}

type ComponentMeta = Map & {
    title: string?,
    description: string?,
    status: string?,
    icon: string?,
    agent_id: string?,
    version: integer?,
    version_count: integer?,
    file_count: integer?,
    bundle_size: integer?,
}

type ComponentRow = {
    component_id: string,
    meta: ComponentMeta?,
}

-- The skills trait build func (init_skills) contribution: empty when nothing is
-- pinned, otherwise the pinned-skills prompt section the compiler appends.
type Contribution = { prompt: string? }

M.Map = Map
M.Scalar = Scalar
M.SkillFile = SkillFile
M.SkillFileInput = SkillFileInput
M.SkillFileManifest = SkillFileManifest
M.SkillBundle = SkillBundle
M.SkillCreateArgs = SkillCreateArgs
M.SkillRefineArgs = SkillRefineArgs
M.SkillShareArgs = SkillShareArgs
M.SkillDeleteArgs = SkillDeleteArgs
M.VersionSelector = VersionSelector
M.SkillGetArgs = SkillGetArgs
M.SkillListVersionsArgs = SkillListVersionsArgs
M.SkillListFilesArgs = SkillListFilesArgs
M.SkillReadFileArgs = SkillReadFileArgs
M.SkillListArgs = SkillListArgs
M.SkillToolArgs = SkillToolArgs
M.Skill = Skill
M.SkillSummary = SkillSummary
M.SkillVersion = SkillVersion
M.SkillFileContent = SkillFileContent
M.VersionRecord = VersionRecord
M.RefineResult = RefineResult
M.ShareResult = ShareResult
M.DeleteResult = DeleteResult
M.ComponentCommand = ComponentCommand
M.ComponentMeta = ComponentMeta
M.ComponentRow = ComponentRow
M.Contribution = Contribution

-- kickside_component_meta.class discriminator for skill components (discovery vocabulary).
M.SKILL_CLASS = "kickside.skills"

-- impl_id stored on the skill's components row.
M.SKILL_IMPL = "kickside.skills:skill"

-- The skill's event-log thread: the skill component's primary thread
-- (thread_id == skill_id), holding the version events the projection folds.
M.THREAD_CLASS = M.SKILL_CLASS

-- Thread event types: a skill version is born with `created` and each refinement
-- appends `updated`. body carries the full version snapshot (body + frontmatter +
-- file manifest of artifact_ids).
M.EVENT = {
    CREATED = "kickside.skills.events:skill.created",
    UPDATED = "kickside.skills.events:skill.updated",
}

-- The version-history projection kind state.lua reads the body of. Its full config
-- (worker_ref/input_mode) is declared on the `skill` KIND binding (single source)
-- and auto-applied by the engine when the history thread passes that kind as its
-- declaration impl_id; only the kind name is needed here to locate the materialized
-- body.
M.PROJECTION_KIND = "kickside.skills:history"

-- A skill is surfaced to agents while active; archived skills are hidden from
-- discovery (set via refine; reversible).
M.STATUS = { ACTIVE = "active", ARCHIVED = "archived" }

-- A skill version bundles a markdown body with reference/asset/script files.
-- kind drives how a file is surfaced: a reference is loaded into context on
-- demand, an asset is a binary the procedure depends on, a script is reserved
-- for the follow-on script runner and is stored, never run, in V1.
M.FILE_KIND = { REFERENCE = "reference", ASSET = "asset", SCRIPT = "script" }

-- Source file encodings the importer accepts. Text is stored as-is; base64 is
-- decoded to raw bytes before storage so the artifact holds the real file.
M.ENCODING = { TEXT = "text", BASE64 = "base64" }

-- Input bounds. name/description mirror the Claude SKILL.md frontmatter limits
-- (name <= 64, description <= 1024); body is capped so a pinned skill cannot
-- blow an agent's context window. FILE caps a single bundled file; BUNDLE caps a
-- version's total file bytes; FILE_COUNT caps how many files one version carries.
M.LIMITS = {
    NAME = 64,
    DESCRIPTION = 1024,
    BODY = 64 * 1024,
    FILE = 1024 * 1024,
    BUNDLE = 8 * 1024 * 1024,
    FILE_COUNT = 256,
    PATH = 512,
}

-- Skill runtime. The runtime contract activates a skill version, lists its
-- files, and reads one file. The default binding is skill_runtime.
M.SKILL_RUNTIME = "kickside.skills:skill_runtime"
M.SKILL_RUNTIME_BINDING = "kickside.skills:skill_runtime_binding"

-- Reserved registry meta.type for a skill script runner. A future SkillScript
-- tool resolves an executable file's runtime to a binding tagged with this type
-- (a registry allowlist, not arbitrary container images). No runner ships in V1.
M.SKILL_RUNNER_TYPE = "kickside.skill_runner"

return M

-- Append one immutable skill version through the public Threads contract.
--
-- The event's external identity is the natural key for a version within a skill.
-- Threads reports a duplicate when that key already exists. A duplicate is only
-- a successful replay when the durable event has the same type, identity, and
-- structured body; a concurrent writer that chose the same version number with
-- different content is a conflict, not a successful refinement.

local json = require("json")

local M = {}

local EXTERNAL_SOURCE = "kickside.skills"

local function deep_equal(left: any, right: any): boolean
    if type(left) ~= type(right) then return false end
    if type(left) ~= "table" then return left == right end

    for key, value in pairs(left :: { [any]: any }) do
        if not deep_equal(value, (right :: { [any]: any })[key]) then return false end
    end
    for key, _ in pairs(right :: { [any]: any }) do
        if (left :: { [any]: any })[key] == nil then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local function event_body(event: any): (any?, string?)
    local body = type(event) == "table" and (event :: any).body or nil
    if type(body) == "table" then return body, nil end
    if type(body) ~= "string" then return nil, "durable event body is missing" end
    local decoded, decode_err = json.decode(body :: string)
    if decode_err or type(decoded) ~= "table" then
        return nil, "durable event body is invalid JSON: " .. tostring(decode_err or "expected object")
    end
    return decoded, nil
end

-- Command-side version decisions consult the immutable history explicitly. This
-- is not a read-model query: it is the writer's concurrency source of truth.
function M.latest(threads: any, thread_id: string, created_type: string, updated_type: string): (any?, string?)
    local listed, list_err = threads:list_events({ thread_id = thread_id, limit = 1000 })
    if list_err then return nil, "skill version history unavailable: " .. tostring(list_err) end
    local events = type(listed) == "table" and (listed :: any).events or nil
    if type(events) ~= "table" then return nil, "invalid skill version history response" end
    for _, event in ipairs(events :: { any }) do
        local event_type = type(event) == "table" and (event :: any).type or nil
        if event_type == created_type or event_type == updated_type then
            return event_body(event)
        end
    end
    return nil, "skill has no versions"
end

local function verify_duplicate(
    threads: any,
    thread_id: string,
    event_type: string,
    record: any,
    external_id: string,
    external_version: string
): string?
    local listed, list_err = threads:list_events({
        thread_id = thread_id,
        event_type = event_type,
        -- Versions are append-only and a duplicate winner is at the head. Keep a
        -- bounded window while allowing for adjacent concurrent event traffic.
        limit = 1000,
    })
    if list_err then
        return "skill version duplicate verification failed: " .. tostring(list_err)
    end
    local events = type(listed) == "table" and (listed :: any).events or nil
    if type(events) ~= "table" then
        return "skill version duplicate verification failed: invalid list_events response"
    end

    for _, event in ipairs(events :: { any }) do
        if type(event) == "table"
            and (event :: any).type == event_type
            and (event :: any).external_source == EXTERNAL_SOURCE
            and (event :: any).external_id == external_id
            and tostring((event :: any).external_version or "") == external_version then
            local persisted, body_err = event_body(event)
            if body_err then return "skill version duplicate verification failed: " .. body_err end
            if deep_equal(persisted, record) then return nil end
            return "skill version conflict: version " .. external_version
                .. " already exists with different content"
        end
    end

    return "skill version duplicate verification failed: durable event was not found"
end

function M.append(
    threads: any,
    thread_id: string,
    event_type: string,
    record: any,
    impl_id: string,
    thread_class: string
): string?
    local version = tostring(type(record) == "table" and (record :: any).version or "")
    local external_id = "version:" .. version
    local result, append_err = threads:emit({
        component_id = thread_id,
        type = event_type,
        role = "user",
        body = record,
        impl_id = impl_id,
        thread_class = thread_class,
        content = {
            content_type = "text/markdown",
            content_mode = "inline",
            content_bytes = #(tostring(type(record) == "table" and (record :: any).body or "")),
        },
        external = {
            external_source = EXTERNAL_SOURCE,
            external_id = external_id,
            external_version = version,
        },
    })
    if append_err then return tostring(append_err) end
    if type(result) ~= "table" then return "invalid Threads emit response" end

    local duplicates = tonumber((result :: any).duplicates) or 0
    if duplicates > 0 then
        return verify_duplicate(threads, thread_id, event_type, record, external_id, version)
    end
    if (tonumber((result :: any).inserted) or 0) ~= 1 then
        return "invalid Threads emit result: expected one inserted event"
    end
    return nil
end

return M
